scripts.features:
This script allows you to orbit around and spectate any player in the game using a customizable user interface. It provides features such as adjustable orbit speed, height, and distance, along with a toggleable spectate mode.

Features:
Orbit Player - Enable whenever you want.

Speed Slider - Change the speed of the orbit, the more will be the more faster. If you do not want to get hit by guns in da hood or something, it is recommended to use 100-150.

Height Slider - Adjust the vertical position of the orbit.

Distance Slider - Adjust how far to be from the target player.

Spectate Toggle - If you ever feel buggy you can just spectate the target player.
